#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os
import shutil

def main():
    cpu = os.cpu_count()
    cols = shutil.get_terminal_size().columns
    write_perm = os.access(".", os.W_OK)

    print(f"CPU: {cpu}")
    print(f"Terminal Width: {cols}cols")
    print(f"Write Perm: {write_perm}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
